🛡️ Home Insurance Guide
Protect your biggest investment
Is Your Home Insured?
🏠 Structure Insurance
Covers: Fire, flood, earthquake, storm damage to your home structure. From ₹3,000/year.
🪑 Contents Insurance
Covers: Furniture, electronics, appliances inside your home. From ₹2,000/year.
🔨 Construction Insurance
Covers: Damage during construction phase. Mandatory for large projects.
⚡ Natural Calamity
Covers: Earthquake, flood, cyclone. Rajasthan earthquake zone — must have.

🏛️ Property Tax Estimator
Property tax rules are set by each city's own municipal corporation and genuinely differ across India. Pick your city below for the real system it uses.
City
Rajasthan municipalities (incl. Jodhpur & Jaipur) use a real, fixed formula: UD Tax = (Area in sq yd × DLC Rate) ÷ 2000. Residential plots up to 300 sq yd are exempt. DLC rates are set per locality/road-width by the District Level Committee — look yours up on epanjiyan.nic.in or your last receipt.
